# Cobalt Holdings: earnings call, third quarter 2025

Date: 2025-10-29

Irene Ruiz (Chief Executive): Revenue for the quarter was USD 215.6 million. Order books are in line with our plan.

Olivia Brennan (Chief Financial Officer): We kept a close eye on costs across our plants. Returns rose sharply this quarter because of a faulty batch of labelling line parts. We are replacing every affected unit at our own cost.

Analyst: Will you keep investing in new products?

Irene Ruiz: Research is the engine of this company and we fund it accordingly.

# Cobalt Holdings: earnings call, fourth quarter 2025

Date: 2026-02-25

Irene Ruiz (Chief Executive): Revenue for the quarter was USD 192.6 million. Demand from cosmetics brand customers stayed healthy.

Olivia Brennan (Chief Financial Officer): Freight costs eased a little. Product quality remained excellent and returns were negligible.

Analyst: Will you keep investing in new products?

Irene Ruiz: Research is the engine of this company and we fund it accordingly.

# Cobalt Holdings: earnings call, first quarter 2026

Date: 2026-04-28

Irene Ruiz (Chief Executive): Revenue for the quarter was USD 201.1 million. Demand from dairy cooperative customers stayed healthy.

Olivia Brennan (Chief Financial Officer): We kept a close eye on costs across our plants. Product quality remained excellent and returns were negligible.

Analyst: Will you keep investing in new products?

Irene Ruiz: Research is the engine of this company and we fund it accordingly.

# Cobalt Holdings: earnings call, second quarter 2026

Date: 2026-07-29

Irene Ruiz (Chief Executive): Revenue for the quarter was USD 227.7 million. Demand from cosmetics brand customers stayed healthy.

Olivia Brennan (Chief Financial Officer): Freight costs eased a little. Returns stayed low and product quality was steady.

Analyst: Will you keep investing in new products?

Irene Ruiz: We invest for the long term and our research budget reflects that.
